name: re-discipline
description: Evidence-based reverse-engineering knowledge: local retrieval and remote community search, with operator-owned publishing.

interface.shortDescription: Curated RE knowledge: search it, campaign it, promote findings.
interface.longDescription: Curate reverse-engineering findings in .re-discipline/docs/ and search local or remote community knowledge. Server operators create communities and publish findings; readers connect to individual public or private search engines without downloading a corpus.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search with re-search before investigating. Pass the active project's absolute root and follow .re-discipline/CONVENTIONS.md.
